fact_evidence.evidence: OpenStax places kidneys on either side of the spine retroperitoneally and says the right is lower due to the liver; it distinguishes cortex and medulla, gives Figure 25.8 exact title Left Kidney, and describes nephrons as functional units that cleanse blood.
